fact: Italic is one property of the whole text element, turned on and off by an "Italic" toggle next to the text align control (tooltip "Italic (Ctrl+I)") or by Ctrl+I / Cmd+I; there is no partial italic, no separate italic font, and bold is out of scope.

fact: Italic may be a synthetic oblique in any font; italic text stays readable and unclipped in Latin, Cyrillic, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Hebrew, emoji and mixed scripts, and italic never changes text direction or alignment.
